display.title: Episode 137: The Strange Visitor
display.summary_short: Orphaned little Yisroelik, who fears only Hashem, studies alone in a forest cave until a mysterious old man becomes his teacher. Plus Reb Nature sings 'Mitzvah Man'.
display.summary_long: Music returns after the Three Weeks with a lively march and a sponsor message. A returning young guest shows the wallet and ID card he received from Tzivos Hashem and talks with Uncle Yossi about fighting the Yetzer Hara with the secret weapon of Torah and mitzvos, then leads the Shema. Story time tells of Yisroelik, a bright boy orphaned at five, who always remembers his father's last words: fear nothing and no one, only Hashem. He finds an empty cave in the woods and secretly goes there with his siddur, Chumash and Tehillim to daven and learn. One day footsteps approach, and a stranger with a silvery white beard asks whether he is afraid all alone. Yisroelik answers that he is never alone, because Hashem is with him, and asks only to learn more Torah. The old man becomes his teacher, and the boy grows up to be the Baal Shem Tov. Then Reb Nature returns to Studio 604 with a fiddler and leads a sing-along, 'Mitzvah Man', about a hero who races around the world doing mitzvos. The mailbox brings a warm letter from a large family who listen together every Tuesday night.
display.lesson: Fear nothing and no one but Hashem; one who is with Hashem is never alone, and Hashem sends help to a child who truly wants to learn Torah.
